MCP servers Kantel calls for tools: the registry, tunnel tokens and each server's tools.

:::caution
Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_TOOL_SERVERS=experimental`.
:::

## List tool servers

`GET /v1/tool-servers` (SDK method `listToolServers`)

The tool servers the caller may read, by name: the organisation's and its projects'. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_TOOL_SERVERS=experimental`.

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `projectId` | string | no | Only this project's servers and the organisation's: what its sessions could see. |
| `limit` | integer | no |  (minimum 1, maximum 500) |
| `cursor` | string | no | A previous page's `nextCursor`. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [ToolServerPage](/api/reference/types/#toolserverpage) (`application/json`). A page of tool servers.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Register a tool server

`POST /v1/tool-servers` (SDK method `createToolServer`)

Registers an MCP server for the organisation or one of its projects; needs admin on the owner. The name is unique in the organisation (`conflict` otherwise). A `tunnel` server comes with its first tunnel token, shown in this answer only. Only `tunnel` is accepted yet. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_TOOL_SERVERS=experimental`.

**Body**: object

**Answers**

- `201`: [CreatedToolServer](/api/reference/types/#createdtoolserver) (`application/json`). The server, and its first token.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Get a tool server

`GET /v1/tool-servers/{toolServerId}` (SDK method `getToolServer`)

The server, whether its side is connected, and its latest tools. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_TOOL_SERVERS=experimental`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `toolServerId` | string | yes |  |

**Answers**

- `200`: [ToolServer](/api/reference/types/#toolserver) (`application/json`). The server.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Change a tool server

`PATCH /v1/tool-servers/{toolServerId}` (SDK method `updateToolServer`)

Its description, or which tools are disabled. A disabled tool isn't offered to new sessions; one a session was offered already stays in its list, which never changes under it, and its calls answer an error result. Needs admin on the owner. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_TOOL_SERVERS=experimental`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `toolServerId` | string | yes |  |

**Body**: object

**Answers**

- `200`: [ToolServer](/api/reference/types/#toolserver) (`application/json`). The server.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Remove a tool server

`DELETE /v1/tool-servers/{toolServerId}` (SDK method `removeToolServer`)

Removes the server and its tokens and closes its tunnel. Needs admin on the owner. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_TOOL_SERVERS=experimental`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `toolServerId` | string | yes |  |

**Answers**

- `204`: no body. Removed.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## List a tool server's tunnel tokens

`GET /v1/tool-servers/{toolServerId}/tokens` (SDK method `listToolServerTokens`)

Each token's ID, prefix and when it was made and last used; never the token. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_TOOL_SERVERS=experimental`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `toolServerId` | string | yes |  |

**Answers**

- `200`: [ToolServerTokenList](/api/reference/types/#toolservertokenlist) (`application/json`). The tokens.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Make a tunnel token

`POST /v1/tool-servers/{toolServerId}/tokens` (SDK method `createToolServerToken`)

A new tunnel token, `ktt_…`, shown in this answer only; Kantel keeps its hash. Older tokens keep working until revoked. Needs operator on the owner. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_TOOL_SERVERS=experimental`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `toolServerId` | string | yes |  |

**Answers**

- `201`: [IssuedToolServerToken](/api/reference/types/#issuedtoolservertoken) (`application/json`). The token, with its secret.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Revoke a tunnel token

`DELETE /v1/tool-servers/{toolServerId}/tokens/{tokenId}` (SDK method `revokeToolServerToken`)

Revokes the token and closes any tunnel it opened. Needs operator on the owner. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_TOOL_SERVERS=experimental`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `toolServerId` | string | yes |  |
| `tokenId` | string | yes |  |

**Answers**

- `204`: no body. Revoked.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Get a tool server's tools

`GET /v1/tool-servers/{toolServerId}/tools` (SDK method `getToolServerTools`)

The latest snapshot of the server's `tools/list`, each tool with whether it is enabled, the name the model sees (`<server>__<tool>`), and why a session couldn't be offered it, such as a name too long. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_TOOL_SERVERS=experimental`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `toolServerId` | string | yes |  |

**Answers**

- `200`: [ToolServerTools](/api/reference/types/#toolservertools) (`application/json`). The server's tools.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).
